title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE SHARPER FIGHTS
why: The card was stamped v24.34 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v24.34 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind. Its new line names the graphics builds of the last half hour: readable silhouettes (his answer 24), bullet marks, blast scars, the first-frame muzzle flash and the redrawn Crier.
now: The what is new card names the sharper fights.
